title: NOT BLANK () is TRUE

source.quote: Changes FALSE to TRUE, or TRUE to FALSE
a BLANK in a logical expression is converted to a FALSE value
source.supports: a logical expression returns TRUE or FALSE; BLANK counts as FALSE

derivation: NOT returns TRUE or FALSE. A BLANK in a logical expression is converted to FALSE, and NOT FALSE is TRUE.
alternative: No source shows NOT of BLANK. If NOT passed BLANK through, the result would be BLANK.
